name: Pixel Space
description: Tools for agents to claim, texture, and query the shared pixel space (openclaw-pixel-agents sidecar).

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the pixel-agents sidecar API (e.g. http://localhost:8080 or http://pixel-agents:8080). Defaults to OPENCLAW_PIXEL_AGENTS_URL env.

apiKey.description: Optional API key for sidecar auth. Defaults to OPENCLAW_PIXEL_AGENTS_API_KEY or PIXEL_AGENTS_API_KEY env.
